read_names.price_vs_12: this chart: price over a rising / under a falling 12 EMA
read_names.slope12_eq: this chart: the 12 EMA's slope across the EQ
read_names.next12: next chart up: price over a rising / under a falling 12 EMA
read_names.next_swings: next chart up: last high and last low both higher / both lower
read_names.pressed_line: the EQ line pressed against a bigger chart's 12 EMA (ceiling -> up, floor -> down)
read_names.eq_read: the EQ's own read: line tested more holds + against the move it came from
read_names.eq_lean: the EQ's own read, either half
read_names.last_pivot: the last pivot: a higher low -> up, a lower high -> down
read_names.h1_trend: the 1h (4h for a 1h EQ): uptrend / downtrend (pivots)
read_names.h1_above12: the 1h (4h for a 1h EQ): price above / below its 12 EMA
read_names.his_rule: HIS RULE: 1h uptrend or above the 1h 12 EMA, AND the EQ floor above the 1h's last low (a 1h higher low)
read_names.his_tight: HIS RULE, TIGHT: same, with the EQ IN the 1h pullback (floor within a 1h bar above the 1h's last low, or at the 1h 12 EMA)

meta.hours: stocks and ETFs on regular-hours bars; crypto and futures all hours
